_: Written by hand. Letters live in Synapse, which the recording never reaches, so each underworld's soul gets one short exchange with its hall. Plain wording only: no lore is claimed here that the app does not already say.

cn.zh: 转生申请已经递上了，想问还要等多久。
cn.en: I have sent my rebirth application. How long is the wait?

cn.zh: 申请已收到，正在审。有结果会在这里回信。
cn.en: It has been received and is being reviewed. The answer will come here.

eu.en: How much longer do I stay here?

eu.zh: 刑期写在你的受刑计划里。期满之后，会送你去下一处。
eu.en: Your term is written in your sentence plan. When it ends, you will be sent on to the next place.

eg.zh: 称心已毕。你的记录已经入簿。
eg.en: The weighing is over. Your record has been entered in the ledger.

gr.en: I would like to apply to go back.

gr.zh: 申请已收到。判官看过之后，会在这里回信。
gr.en: It has been received. The judges will reply here once they have read it.
